description: Passive contribution: builds a counterparty_delivery_receipt for an x402 purchase you already made (tx looked up on-ledger), signed by the paying wallet. With submit=true it is sent to Lumi signed with your contributor key (LUMI_CONTRIB_KEY_FILE); Lumi verifies it on-ledger before it counts. Submitting is tier 2 receipt sharing: OFF by default, so submit=true sends nothing until you opt in (LUMI_SHARE_RECEIPTS=1 or `lumi-scan sharing on`). A receipt shares the payment's chain and transaction ID (tx hash), no amount or wallet field; a transaction ID is public on-chain and can be linked to the paying wallet. Checked receipts earn a public contributor badge only (nothing of monetary value). No new spend. Self-tests (your own endpoints or wallets) are rejected.

endpoint.description: The x402 resource URL you paid

http_status.description: HTTP status of the paid response (0 = timeout)

submit.description: Send to Lumi (default false: return the signed receipt only)

name: lumi_report_receipt
title: Lumi Check: report a purchase you already made (passive)
